From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 10:17:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Renewal paperwork + our redline notes

David/LA — forwarding my notes after a first pass. I annotated MSA_v3_marked.docx — highlights below: 

1) Data retention / deletion (Green Horizon ask): their language asks for deletion confirmation within 7 days for all customer-provided PII on request. We can commit to deletion of customer data in active indices and backups within 30 days; 7 days is operationally risky, especially for archived backups. Recommend counterproposal: 30/90 (30 days for live infra, up to 90 days for backups/recovery images) + audit log confirmation.

2) Indemnity carveout tied to regulatory fines: we cannot accept open-ended caps tied to third-party regulatory penalties. Propose keeping the indemnity cap at the negotiated contract cap (standard) and instead add a good-faith cooperation obligation and expedited incident remediation SLA credits.

3) 36-month term / price protection: legal is comfortable adding a price-stability clause for the first 12 months (no unit price increases) and an annual review thereafter tied to a defined CPI micro-index. We should avoid an absolute price guarantee for the full 36 months.

4) Order form structure: agree that uplift as separate line-item is clearer. Need to confirm exact ramp months (month 1: baseline, month 3: uplift active). Also call out billing proration and whether unused tokens roll over (recommended: no rollover unless expressly negotiated).

5) Approval path & signers: procurement wants single-sign Docusign. If Green Horizon requires additional signers (IT security or legal), spell them out now.

Action items:
- David: confirm if we can accept 30/90 retention counterproposal to Alexa.
- Lauren: draft the counter redline to MSA_v3_marked.docx and generate a clean order form with separate uplift line and billing proration language.

Kimberly
Sr. Counsel, Contracts & Privacy
Redwood Inference

Attachment: MSA_v3_marked.docx (commented)

Thanks, David and Kimberly — this is helpful. A few quick responses: 

- Green Horizon is okay with a 30/90 deletion window as a counterproposal — procurement flagged 7 days as aspirational. Please include the audit confirmation language.
- Indemnity: they are firm on a limited carveout but will accept a cooperation + remediation credit approach if we provide a clear incident playbook (they requested an example runbook).
- Signers: procurement confirms a single docusign signature will be sufficient; IT Security wants to be cc’d on the signed copy for their records.
- Billing: they prefer separate uplift line-item. They want an explicit proration example in the order form for partial-month ramp.

Next steps per procurement: please send a counter redline to MSA_v3_marked.docx and a new order form with uplift line + proration example. If we can get that by end of day Thursday (13 May), procurement will queue a PO for their next cycle. Otherwise, they’ll defer to the following cycle.
